answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent locks 50 POA, released when three peers echo the job's proof to the ledger. A forged proof burns the deposit in layers: the shale-thin top burns first, and the rest smoulders to an ember over ten epochs. Forging 1,000 identities burns 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA, while an honest agent risks one deposit, returned in full. Honest agents pay once; sybils pay per slot and lose all.
